# [PTS] Atlantic City: Comes with 4 new expeditions, new factions & new quests (70+ new screenshots)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_218_nukaknights-post-atlantic-city-3expeditions-3factions-new-quests.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**[Update 11/15/2023]** New article about Atlantic City: Expected changes for Patch 48: Atlantic City / Season 15 on December 5, 2023

The next big content update awaits us on December 5th, 2023: Atlantic City. As announced, the update primarily includes new expeditions. But there will also be new quests in Atlantic City. There are also some new / revised locations and numerous new rewards. 

Not all of it will appear on December 5th, 2023. The Atlantic City content will be distributed over 2 updates. In the first update, 2 Atlantic City expeditions await us. The third expedition in Atlantic City and a (possible) new expedition in The PITT will be released in the second update.

## New Expeditions

### Atlantic City

- **Tax Evasion**
This is about Billy Beltbuckles, the mafia's accountant (The Family), who fudges the books a bit to avoid paying the accountants and entertainers.
- **The Most Sensational Game**
This is a deadly race against the Batsuuri twins, with danger lurking around every corner. Both obstacles and opponents must be overcome to reach the goal.
- **(2nd Update) The Human Condition**
More information will follow.

### The P.I.T.T. (tbc)

- **(2nd Update tbc) Poke the Beehive**
Note: The PITT Expedition has not yet been officially announced, but can already be found in the game files and listed in the wiki. We'll see whether it will be released in the 2nd update or at another time.

## Main quests (2nd update)

- Opportunity knocks / Opportunity Knocking
- The whole world is a stage / All the World's a Stage
- Sins of the Father

## Side quests (2nd update)

- The Purge / Custodial Compulsions
- Regent der Toten / Regent of the Dead

## New factions:

- **City Auditor / Municipal Auditor Government**
These hard-working citizens keep life running in Atlantic City and aren't afraid to get their hands dirty collecting taxes.
- **The Family / The Family**
These gangsters are based in the casino district and are responsible for vice, drugs and gambling in the city.
- **Entertainer / The Showmen**
Artists and entertainers of all kinds who provide entertainment in the city. They are obsessed with self-actualization and will go to dangerous or even fatal lengths to achieve it.
- (Secondary faction) Clown Faction / Clown Faction

Each expedition helps a faction achieve its goals. The quests also revolve around these factions.

In Atlantic City it's also about the designer drug: "**Devils Blood**". Several areas also revolve around procurement and distribution.

Side Quests: A story revolves around a family that comes to AC. As a player, you help this family through some difficulties.

Fun Fact: In a quest with the Clown faction there will be a "throwing cake" that is equipped like a grenade.
